board: Apple J613 / T8122, fanless MacBook Air
source_findings: apple_fast_die_init returns without creating a limiter if apple,fast-die-effort is absent and the matched SoC does not require that policy. T8122 matches the T8112 fallback driver entry.
T8122 PMP report source explicitly states temperature record positions are unknown and does not register PMP temperature telemetry.
interpretation: Firmware startup and GPU thermal limiting are evidenced. The optional Linux fast-die CPU QoS limiter is not wired through the current device tree. This does not prove absence of firmware or hardware CPU protection; CPU thermal response remains unqualified. Linux cooling devices can represent throttling and do not imply fans.
changes_made: None; no stress load, clock change, register write, module reload or protection change.
